annotations.title: Restore a post or page from the trash

description: Brings ONE item back from the trash. It always comes back as a DRAFT, so it is not live, even if it was before: `previousStatus` says what it was. To put it live again, use update-content with status=publish, which needs the site’s “Publish without your review” extra, or ask the owner. list-content with status=trash shows what is there.
name: agentimus-restore-content

previousStatus.description: What it was before the trash.

status.description: What it is now: trash, or draft after a restore.
